## Component Factory
- **Status:** Required
- **Type:** Factory Binding `Injects.ComponentsFactory`

### Description
The ComponentsFactory is the intended place to inject any visual components that should behave consistently across all game projects i.e. Cabinet and BigWin

This enables the components to be accessible from both the game code and the BasePackage code, with the flexibility to change their functionality if a project wants to try something new.

The factory is called early in the Bootstrap process:
- After connecting to Parent
- After Injecting the Skin
- After Injecting Admin Settings
- Before Loading any assets
- Before a Resume request

### Components
The components that currently should be built in the ComponentsFactory include:
- [Cabinet](./cabinet.md)
- [BigWin](./big-win.md)

### Example
```ts
bind<() => void>(Injects.ComponentFactory).toFactory(() => {
    return () => {
        bind<Cabinet>(Injects.Cabinet).toConstantValue(new Cabinet());
        bind<BigWin>(Injects.BigWin).toConstantValue(new BigWin());
    };
});
```
